metadata.scope: C++ metadata and symbol addresses; memory layout is not wire serialization order; virtual overrides need base-slot verification.

scope: Matched native spline routing and selected animation behavior; no proprietary code bytes or disassembly included.

facts.contract: The spline instruction stores mLoadFromJson as a bool at offset37. Core checks its true value to choose named playback; false selects inline data.
Named playback searches the registered definition vector in order using exact string length and byte comparison. A missing name returns before replacing the path.
Named playback uses registered definition duration at offset32, not instruction duration. Inline playback reads its instruction duration.
Named types pass through Util::toLower and recognize only catmullrom and linear; inline enum values are CatmullRom0 and Linear1, and other values do not create a recognized curve.
Named definition construction supplies catmullrom as its default type. Omitted inline wire-field initialization is not established by this observation.
Keyframe time fields are seconds and copied unchanged into runtime layers. Runtime interpolation uses the starting keyframe easing, and directly interpolates all three rotation components.

CameraAnimationDataComponent current time is incremented by delta time. If current time exceeds duration without looping, animation storage/data are cleared and components removed. The subsequent selected pose is not established here.

limits: No proof of every supported protocol wire schema.
No proof of omitted inline curve-type initialization.
Full spline curve construction, degenerate points and numeric endpoint behavior remain unclosed.
Animation cleanup alone does not establish the post-animation camera pose.
No general native malformed-packet/disconnect policy inferred.
